claim: Patchline ships a one-command full reproduction rebuilding every study, figure, and number in a clean container. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the one-command full reproduction claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make one-command-full-repro-2-gate`.
